formattedAddress: No. 163-11號, Section 5, Nanjing E Rd, Dongguang Village, Songshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 105

displayName.text: LA PIADA - Gastronomia 義式薄餅店

text.text:
Authentic Italian bistro in Taipei 🇮🇹

La Piada is a hidden gem for real Italian flavors in Taipei. The ‘piada’ Italian flatbread is a must-try: it’s a “wrap-like” sandwich. I had a piada, a salad with prosciutto, and Italian sparkling tea. Everything I tried was delicious! Place is cozy offering both indoor and outdoor seatings.

Their deli counter is stocked with top-quality cheeses, cured meats, marinated olives, and lasagna. They also offer a great selection of Italian wines, olive oils, sauces, and pantry items. Warm service and cozy vibes make this spot perfect for a quick bite or grabbing gourmet ingredients.

Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

text.text: Nice dinner.  We had a mix of dishes, plus a bottle of wine.  Piada better than Bergamo (Where we travel for business).  Boss was nice as staff.  Let us sit outside after they closed (We left about 9:45pm or so).  Nice alternative to the standard Italian food served in Taiwan.

text.text: Deli specializing in Italian meats and cheeses. Also offers a selection of fresh-frozen dishes to take home, alongside some sundries. Has a selection of sandwiches available for dine in as well. Usually a lasagna or eggplant parmesan as well, and light alcohol offerings. Really an amazing little spot for a neighborhood pop-in or to get items you've been missing from abroad. Highly recommended.
